editorial:
Imagine you are totally stressed out with work and just want someone to handle your kid's big birthday party. That is exactly where you find Kayla, a gallery owner who is way too busy to plan her daughter Kerry's Sweet Sixteen. Enter Lindy, the perfect party planner who seems upbeat, helpful, and kind. Everything feels great at first, but you quickly realize that Lindy is actually a ticking time bomb. She has a dark secret involving her dead husband and a scary obsession with becoming a mother. The vibe starts off light and breezy, but it slowly turns into a tense game of cat and mouse as Lindy tries to push Kayla out of the picture to take over as the mom.

You will probably love how the tension builds up, even if some of the plot points feel a bit like a soap opera. The acting is solid, especially the way the villain switches from sweet to scary in a heartbeat. It is not the deepest story ever told, but it keeps you guessing and moving forward. If you are in the mood for some light suspense, you should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this thriller handy for a rainy weekend.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Lindy's plan to steal Kerry away finally falls apart. After a scary confrontation where Lindy shows her true colors, Kayla fights back to protect her daughter. There is a tense struggle where the truth about Lindy's past crimes comes to light. Eventually, Lindy is stopped before she can do any more harm. The movie wraps up with Kayla and Kerry safe, having learned that not everyone who seems perfect is actually a good person.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Lifetime style thrillers and stories about obsessed villains.
